Ellen CSM: Quick QBR flag — account KESTRELAI spiked embed token usage ~3x in last 36h. Need a 1-slide root-cause + 3-scenario spend forecast + mitigation recommendations for tomorrow's renewal review.

Marco (FinOps): I can run baseline/expected/surge scenarios. Send me last 60d and commit.

Ivy (Enablement): I'll draft a short "embed hygiene" checklist and a tiny code snippet customers can drop in to enable batching.

Kai Eng: Seeing a flood of small parallel embed calls from a background worker job. Adding a temporary soft throttle for bulk endpoints and tagging calls missing the batch-size header.

billing-bot: Alert: KESTRELAI reached 79% of monthly allocation. AlertID: bill-5590

Ellen CSM: Action list: Marco 1: forecast + cushion rec by 11:30. Kai 1: telemetry tag + soft throttle (ETA 15m). Ivy 1: checklist by EOD. I'll prep the customer outreach offering a short remediation call.

Marco (FinOps): Quick peek: 30d=980k, 7d=410k, monthly_commit=1.1M.
Projections:
- baseline ~1.2M
- trend ~1.7M
- worst ~2.4M
Recommend 15% renewal cushion and temporary soft throttle until batching adoption.

Kai Eng: Throttle deployed, telemetry tag added. Monitoring for 2 hours.

Ivy (Enablement): Draft checklist: enable batching header, set max_batch_size=64, use prefix caching, downsample background jobs. Snippet ready.

Ellen CSM: Great. Marco 1: please include a before/after slide with savings if batching yields 2.5x reduction on impacted routes. I'll post the customer note in #customer-comm for review in 30m.
